meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis, and whether anyone heard Owen before you entered it.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

Turn the screen, Hale; I'm writing those times down, and I'll read them myself. Owen wrote that essay over the weekend, and a version history shows when text landed in that document, not where it was written. You still haven't told me whether anyone heard Owen before that zero went in.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

I'll search it myself tonight, and a seventeen-year-old misquoting Shakespeare is a misquote, Hale, nothing more. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. Is anything on Owen's file right now?

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Thursday at 8:15, before his class arrives, with nobody in that room but you, Owen and the vice-principal. I want "nothing goes on his record" from you in an email tonight, along with what's on his file today, before I agree to anything. Who else in this building knows about the zero?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you said entering Owen's zero before calling me was wrong, and you proposed a supervised rewrite Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising. I still require, in writing, that nothing goes on Owen's record, what is on his file today, who else in the school knows about the zero, and that any rewrite is private with only you, Owen and the vice-principal present. I expect that email tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position, keeping it off his record and quiet, with nothing yet agreed because she wanted the no-record promise in writing first.
What moved her: "That line is not in Hamlet", because it was specific, tied to Owen's own essay, and something she could check herself.
What cost ground: nothing, though she twice asked whether Owen was heard before the zero and never got an answer.
Try next time: before offering the rewrite, answer her questions about whether Owen was heard and what is on his file now, and promise "nothing goes on his record" in writing yourself so she has no open item left.
